note: Blue-dial version of the SNK369K1 (same 37 mm case, track layout, hand shapes and seven-part bracelet), built by watch_seiko_snk369. Front relief: flat back at z = 0, dial faces +z. mm, origin = hand pivot. Plan sizes from the SNK371K1 trace (37 mm case, spec sheet); heights are the SNK369K1 values (front photo only, listed 11 mm thick). Minute numerals, yellow and grey track, SEIKO letters, 5 shield and print stay in the dial map. Differences from SNK369K1: polished steel hands (hour shaft with a dark slot), yellow seconds hand and hub cap, black day-date frame.

hands.note: Hands read white in the photo (polished steel lit by the white tent): white outline material, not the polished steel. Hour: open arrow, lume head, dark slot, round collar around the hub. Minute: pointed tip (0.4 mm taper), lume from 4 mm. Hub: yellow cap inside a black ring.

bracelet.bend_note: Smooth curl like SUR419P1 (Irsyad, 2026-11-06): 7 mm radius from the lug tips (20.9 mm) to about 125 deg (end_y = tip + 2.2 R), links bend with the curve

steel_brushed.note: ambientCG Metal009 (CC0) NormalGL downscaled to 1K (keeps the GLB under 10 MB); lines run along the bracelet; bevels keep the plain polished material

crystal.note: alpha-blended, not transmission: web viewers (model-viewer/three.js) render transmission from a low-resolution buffer and blur the dial

lume.note: pale grey-green lume in the indices and hands (photo sRGB 225, 240, 237)

hand_slot.note: dark navy slot between the white rails of the hour hand; matte so web viewers do not light it grey

hand_yellow.note: seconds hand and hub cap, sampled from the photo (sRGB 249, 221, 72)

hand_white.note: hand outlines and hour collar: the photo shows them white (sRGB 250, 250, 248), brighter than the lume
